title: GrowWithHR Maharashtra Shops Wave 5B Governed Source-Controls Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Maharashtra Shops and Establishments source-control snapshot
sourcePack.notes: All five records carry reproducible source-identity fingerprints only. The November 2025 amendment record remains explicitly draft and no full current Act, Rules or final amendment file is represented as controlled.

limitations: The Wave 5B catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not a Maharashtra Shops and Establishments coverage, registration, threshold, working-condition or enforcement determination.

Only organisation-level State-scope, source-readiness, draft-reconciliation, classification-control, worker-count-control, version and escalation statuses plus evidence references are eligible for retrieval context.
Retrieval cannot infer a location, employee count or establishment type, choose a threshold, treat a draft as final, validate a filing or change the deterministic decision.
Source-identity fingerprints identify curated official records only and do not verify the full current page or linked files.

chunks.title: Maharashtra Shops Act source identity
chunks.text: The official Maharashtra labour source listing identifies the 2017 Shops and Establishments Act. Wave 5B uses this record only to confirm that the Act source is registered and reviewed; it does not decide whether a customer establishment is covered.

chunks.title: Maharashtra Shops Rules source identity
chunks.text: The official Maharashtra labour source listing identifies the 2018 Rules. Their presence supports source-readiness review only and does not determine registration, working hours, leave, welfare, safety or record obligations.

chunks.title: Draft amendment status must remain distinct
chunks.text: The November 2025 Gazette record is a draft amendment published for objections and suggestions. Wave 5B must preserve that draft status and cannot treat proposed threshold, form or night-work changes as operative law without a separately controlled final notification.

chunks.title: Official registration service route
chunks.text: The official Maharashtra Labour Department services page lists registration and amendment services under the 2017 Act. It is operational portal context only and does not prove that a customer must register or that any application or certificate is valid.

chunks.title: RTS service-source context
chunks.text: The Labour RTS services page records an online registration route and service timing. It does not determine legal coverage, filing completeness, approval, renewal, amendment or enforcement consequences.

chunks.title: Maharashtra-only source boundary
chunks.text: Wave 5B is limited to a Maharashtra source-readiness review. Multi-state operations, Union Territory routes and establishments outside Maharashtra require separate controlled source packs and qualified jurisdiction review.

chunks.title: Classification and worker-count controls
chunks.text: Establishment type and worker-count band are recorded only as organisation-level control statuses. The product does not infer employee counts, classify the establishment, choose a threshold or calculate any duty.

chunks.title: Version and escalation controls
chunks.text: A controlled amendment register must distinguish enacted, notified, draft, superseded and unresolved materials. Conflicts or missing final instruments remain specialist-review dependencies and cannot be resolved by retrieval or provider output.
